notes: V3.2 — A+ experience update. New Today dashboard and core-loop navigation, a guided first-run setup, and a pre-practice mood check-in with one-tap intent presets. Plus an honest, fully on-device affect layer: optional consent-gated voice and camera-stillness check-ins (no audio or images are ever stored or sent) that render a derived biofield visualization and personalize the Council's guidance. Major accessibility pass (keyboard navigation, focus rings, live regions, screen-reader labels) and a more resilient launch.
